cases.customer_question: What sample modifications and test preparation steps are required when the qualification scope is RF PHY testing only?
question_variants: What sample modification memo should be used for RF PHY testing?
Do RF PHY-only projects use the same sample preparation as general RF testing?
What information is needed before creating an RF PHY test plan?
How should a device be prepared for Bluetooth RF PHY qualification testing?
What documents are required before RF PHY testing can start?
cases.actual_issue: The project scope was RF PHY qualification testing only, but general RF test preparation instructions were initially provided and later corrected. Proper RF PHY-specific sample preparation and test-planning information were required before testing.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Not all Bluetooth RF-related tests use the same preparation instructions. When a project only includes RF PHY qualification testing, the device modifications, questionnaires, and test plan inputs must match that exact scope. Using broader RF testing guidance can create confusion and incorrect preparation.
cases.consultant_answer: The qualification team determined that the project scope was limited to RF PHY testing and therefore required RF PHY-specific sample modification guidance rather than the standard RF test modification instructions. Before generating the test plan, the customer needed to complete the required questionnaires and provide the information necessary for test-plan creation. Sample preparation, IXIT/ICS-related planning inputs, and scope validation were treated as prerequisites for valid RF PHY execution.
cases.decision_logic: Test preparation requirements depend on the exact qualification scope. RF PHY-only testing must use RF PHY-specific preparation instructions and a test plan generated from accurate customer-supplied configuration information.
cases.final_recommendation: Confirm the qualification scope first, provide RF PHY-specific sample modification instructions, collect questionnaire responses, and generate the test plan only after device configuration details are validated.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Incorrect sample preparation or use of the wrong modification guidance can result in invalid test setup, rework, retesting, and delays in qualification execution.
